                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"users\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"auth_user_id\\\", user.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  if (!publicUser) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"profiles\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"user_id\\\", publicUser.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  return !!profile;\\n}\","

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 16959,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"users\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"auth_user_id\\\", user.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  if (!publicUser) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"profiles\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"user_id\\\", publicUser.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  return !!profile;\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 16979,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"export async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17313,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n\\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17337,

                  "lineNumber": 5065,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n  \\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\","

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid type\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid token hash\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @param supabaseClient - Optional Supabase client to use. If not provided, creates a new client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient?: Awaited&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof createClient&gt;&gt;\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = supabaseClient ?? await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"No code provided\")}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n  const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? (hasEmail ? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n  redirect(redirectTo);\n}",

        },
        "contents": "---\ndescription: Coding rules for Supabase Edge Functions\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Writing Supabase Edge Functions\n\nYou're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:\n\n## Guidelines\n\n1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)\n2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.\n3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.\n4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.\n5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.\n6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.\n7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.\n8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:\n   - SUPABASE_URL\n   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_DB_URL\n9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",

        "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# For detailed configuration reference documentation, visit:\n# https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development/cli/config\n# A string used to distinguish different Supabase projects on the same host. Defaults to the\n# working directory name when running &#96;supabase init&#96;.\nproject_id = \"Tappka\"\n\n[api]\nenabled = true\n# Port to use for the API URL.\nport = 54321\n# Schemas to expose in your API. Tables, views and stored procedures in this schema will get API\n# endpoints. &#96;public&#96; and &#96;graphql_public&#96; schemas are included by default.\nschemas = [\"public\", \"graphql_public\"]\n# Extra schemas to add to the search_path of every request.\nextra_search_path = [\"public\", \"extensions\"]\n# The maximum number of rows returns from a view, table, or stored procedure. Limits payload size\n# for accidental or malicious requests.\nmax_rows = 1000\n\n[api.tls]\n# Enable HTTPS endpoints locally using a self-signed certificate.\nenabled = false\n# Paths to self-signed certificate pair.\n# cert_path = \"../certs/my-cert.pem\"\n# key_path = \"../certs/my-key.pem\"\n\n[db]\n# Port to use for the local database URL.\nport = 54322\n# Port used by db diff command to initialize the shadow database.\nshadow_port = 54320\n# Maximum amount of time to wait for health check when starting the local database.\nhealth_timeout = \"2m\"\n# The database major version to use.         "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  const identities = authUser.identities || [];\n  const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile())) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.\n11. File write operations are ONLY permitted on &#96;/tmp&#96; directory. You can use either Deno or Node File APIs.\n12. Use &#96;EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(promise)&#96; static method to run long-running tasks in the background without blocking response to a request. Do NOT assume it is available in the request / execution context.\n\n## Example Templates\n\n### Simple Hello World Function\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\ninterface reqPayload {\n  name: string\n}\n\nconsole.info('server started')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const { name }: reqPayload = await req.json()\n  const data = {\n    message: &#96;Hello ${name} from foo!&#96;,\n  }\n\n  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {\n    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Connection: 'keep-alive' },\n  })\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example Function using Node built-in API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { createServer } from 'node:http'\nimport process from 'node:process'\n\nconst generateRandomString = (length) =&gt; {\n  const buffer = randomBytes(length)\n  return buffer.toString('hex')\n}\n\nconst randomString = generateRandomString(10)\nconsole.log(randomString)\n\nconst server = createServer((req, res) =&gt; {\n  const message = &#96;Hello&#96;\n  res.end(message)\n})\n\nserver.listen(9999)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Using npm packages in Functions\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport express from 'npm:express@4.18.2'\n\nconst app = express()\n\napp.get(/(.*)/, (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.send('Welcome to Supabase')\n})\n\napp.listen(8000)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Generate embeddings using built-in @Supabase.ai API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nconst model = new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const params = new URL(req.url).searchParams",

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n\\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\","

                },

                  "lineNumber": 16539,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 16959,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"users\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"auth_user_id\\\", user.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  if (!publicUser) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"profiles\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"id\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"user_id\\\", publicUser.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  return !!profile;\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 16979,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"export async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17313,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n\\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 17337,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"export async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 17566,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \\\"@/components/verify-email-form\\\";\\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \\\"@/lib/auth-helpers\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Email verification page\\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\\n */\\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\\n\\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\\n  if (!data?.claims) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/auth/login\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\\n  if (hasEmail) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/protected\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full max-w-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;VerifyEmailForm /&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n}\","
